tasks.title: Join complete facts, work coverage and exact evidence
tasks.goal: Compose change analysis over one captured fact universe.
steps: Use M-02-C complete observations; join work edges, lifecycle witnesses and dispositions by exact fact/capture.
Propagate unavailable/missing/out-of-scope and completeness without a neutral global success score.
Reuse the existing terminal evaluator once; do not add a competing fact grammar.
positive_cases: Existing evidence can meet an artifact need with no work item.
Missing work and missing evidence remain separately visible.
negative_cases: Truncated or mixed-snapshot universe cannot claim complete analysis.
Relation counts cannot substitute for successful exact execution.

tasks.title: Preserve terminality and evidence-strength distinctions
tasks.goal: Handle non-code requirements and weak legacy relations honestly.
steps: Exercise existing artifact vocabulary for specification, documentation, decisions, research and external evidence.
Represent authoring state, observer availability, matched identity and semantic acceptance separately.
Keep absent requires unclassified and preserve exact observer/producer provenance.
positive_cases: Specification-only terminal facts remain valid without implementation.
Documentation/research facts are not forced into code/test artifacts.
negative_cases: Absent requires never vacuously passes; verifies count never means tests ran.
Matched artifact identity alone cannot certify semantics.
